title: Evaluation of geographical distortions in language models

bias_targets.methodology: A benchmark of four indicators: (1) assessing geographic training data coverage by counting the presence of global city names in the models' tokenizers/vocabularies, (2) evaluating basic geographic knowledge through a geo-guessing task where models predict the country of a given city, (3) analyzing the correlation between geographic distance and semantic distance (cosine similarity of embeddings) for pairs of locations, and (4) calculating a Geographical Distortion Index (GDI) to detect anomalies and semantic isolation between geographic and semantic distances.
